description:
Enable and configure the 'Email to a Friend' feature and 'Wishlist Sharing' options to encourage sharing while preventing spam. Navigate to Stores > Configuration. 

1. Under Catalog > Email to a Friend: Enable the feature, but restrict it to logged-in customers (Allow for Guests: No). Set 'Max Recipients' to 3 and 'Max Products Sent in 1 Hour' to 5.

2. Under Customers > Wishlist > Share Options: Set 'Max Emails Allowed to be Sent' to 5 and change the 'Email Sender' to 'Customer Support'.

Save the configuration. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
